review.imagery: Eighteen own-project renders were visually reviewed. Seventeen native brochure scenes and one distinct current-gallery living-room angle cover the complete building, aerial, courtyard, roof, balcony pools, lobby and home interiors. Generic people/leaf images, logos, embedded unit-plan resources and the unpainted page-26 alternate building resource are excluded. Final browser review caught a source-cropped roof in the page-28 view and the page-27 street view. The complete page-2 aerial replaces them on the card and hero before verification. Proposed fitout and views remain unit-unspecific.
review.floorPlans: Four complete home drawings and two building sheets come from the original official plan pack. Each home drawing is labeled with a pool. The current primary FAQ limits private pools to selected apartments, so confirm the chosen unit’s configuration. Drawing-specific numerical areas and approved unit matching are absent. The generic category minimum is not a verified area for every layout. All six complete original drawing pages 2–7 were visually reviewed. The first-floor and floors-2–14 footprints remain distinct. All labels, color keys, notices and original page links are retained. No numerical area is inferred from the primary’s category minimum.
review.location: The complete original map and twelve numerical time panels on physical page 31 were visually reviewed. Its approximation notice remains visible. The primary coordinate 25.092084716328028, 55.381957198163235 is recorded with hash and six-place rounding. The Global Village source difference is explicit. No precise entrance, live route, road distance or operational transport claim is inferred.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, official original brochure, duplicate official asset brochure, official plan pack and factsheet retain receipts and hashes. Native image origins, original bytes, unedited drawing pages and physical source links remain available. This is original Ivy Gardens, separate from Ivy Gardens 2. Protected ownership and completed text research are preserved.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical areas, approved unit-to-layout and pool applicability, final fitout, verified visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established.
